name: SDF Ray Marching with Eikonal Correction
definition: Marches a ray through an SDF field, accumulating distance steps to find surface intersection, while applying a correction factor to counteract distance elongation along non-cardinal directions caused by the Eikonal equation.
summary: SDF Ray Marching with Eikonal Correction is a volume rendering technique that adjusts step sizes based on ray direction to prevent overshooting artifacts caused by distance elongation in non-cardinal directions.
